title: Greek Chicken Salad
description: A fresh Mediterranean salad with grilled chicken, cucumber, tomato, and olive oil.
instructions: Season and grill the chicken. Chop the vegetables. Slice the chicken and combine everything in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and serve.

title: Veggie Stir Fry Rice Bowl
description: A colorful Asian-style rice bowl with stir-fried vegetables and simple seasoning.
instructions: Cook the rice. Slice the vegetables. Stir fry the onion, carrot, pepper, and broccoli in olive oil. Serve the vegetables over rice.

title: Black Bean Taco Bowl
description: A Mexican-inspired bowl with black beans, rice, tomato, and onion.
instructions: Cook the rice. Heat the black beans. Chop the tomato and onion. Assemble in a bowl and finish with olive oil.

title: Creamy Pasta Bowl
description: A simple Italian pasta bowl with cheese, tomato, and onion.
instructions: Cook the pasta. Sauté onion and tomato in olive oil. Toss with pasta and melt in the cheese before serving.

title: Chickpea Curry Bowl
description: A cozy Indian-inspired chickpea bowl with onion, tomato, and rice.
instructions: Cook the rice. Sauté onion and tomato in olive oil. Add chickpeas and simmer briefly. Serve over rice.

title: Roasted Sweet Potato Plate
description: A satisfying vegan plate with roasted sweet potato, chickpeas, and spinach.
instructions: Roast the sweet potato. Warm the chickpeas. Plate with spinach and drizzle olive oil on top.

title: Cheesy Veggie Omelet
description: A protein-rich vegetarian omelet with cheese, onion, and tomato.
instructions: Beat the eggs. Cook onion and tomato lightly in olive oil. Add eggs and cheese, fold, and cook until set.

title: Banana Oat Parfait
description: A quick dessert made with oats, banana, yogurt, and honey.
instructions: Layer yogurt, oats, and sliced banana in a glass or bowl. Drizzle with honey and chill before serving.

title: Homestyle Burger Plate
description: A fast food-style burger plate with beef, bread, and onion.
instructions: Shape and cook the beef patty. Toast the bread. Assemble with onion and tomato, then serve warm.

title: Party Nacho Bowl
description: A simple party-style bowl with beans, cheese, tomato, and crunchy sides.
instructions: Warm the beans. Chop the vegetables. Toast the bread into crispy pieces and serve everything layered with cheese.

title: Mini Breakfast Toasts
description: Kid-friendly breakfast toasts with banana and honey.
instructions: Toast the bread. Spread butter lightly. Top with banana slices and drizzle with honey.

title: Lentil Tomato Soup
description: A warm bowl of lentil soup with tomato, onion, and garlic.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil. Add tomato and lentils with water. Simmer until tender and serve hot.

title: Fresh Garden Salad
description: A light salad with lettuce, cucumber, tomato, and olive oil.
instructions: Chop all vegetables, combine in a bowl, and dress with olive oil.

title: Chicken Rice Bowl
description: A balanced main course with chicken, rice, and vegetables.
instructions: Cook the rice. Grill the chicken. Chop the vegetables and steam the broccoli. Plate everything together and drizzle with olive oil.

title: Garlic Bread Bites
description: A quick appetizer with toasted bread, garlic, and butter.
instructions: Toast the bread. Mix butter with minced garlic. Spread over bread and cut into small bites.

title: Global Grain Bowl
description: An international-style grain bowl with rice, beans, and vegetables.
instructions: Cook the rice. Warm the beans. Chop the vegetables and assemble everything in a bowl.

title: Breakfast Oat Bowl
description: A simple breakfast bowl with oats, milk, banana, and honey.
instructions: Cook the oats with milk. Top with banana slices and honey.

title: Grilled Salmon Plate
description: A grilled salmon meal with vegetables and a light side.
instructions: Grill the salmon. Steam the broccoli. Serve with tomato and olive oil.

title: Low Carb Chicken Plate
description: A low carb plate with chicken, spinach, and mushrooms.
instructions: Cook the chicken. Sauté mushrooms and spinach in olive oil. Serve together.

title: High Protein Power Bowl
description: A high protein bowl with chicken, eggs, and rice.
instructions: Cook the rice. Grill the chicken. Boil the eggs. Steam the broccoli and assemble the bowl.
